sodium: Iris 1.8.x for 1.21.1 pins Sodium 0.6.13; the 0.8 line has no matching Iris.
cosy-critters: 0.3.x's ClientLevel mixin targets a method Connector cannot map on NeoForge 1.21.1, so the client exits on startup; 0.0.1a works.
fresh-food: 1.3.x needs Respackopts, whose NeoForge build asks for LibJF modules the NeoForge LibJF does not provide; 1.0 works on its own.
subtle-effects: 1.14.x's End Remastered hook calls JsonEye.getID(), which End Remastered 6.3.0 for 1.21.1 does not have, so the client fails to load; 1.9.4 works.
